Where does approval actually live?
Feedback happens everywhere. Sign-off has to live somewhere. Right now, for most teams, it lives in a Slack scrollback.
EMAIL, SLACK, AND PDFS

The approval is buried in a Slack thread from three Tuesdays ago.

Final_v3_REAL.pdf and its five siblings in the email chain.

The 11pm text: did the client actually sign this off?

Notes arrive by email, WhatsApp, and a call, never on the frame.

A second Slack thread, so the client does not see the internal debate.

BOORDS

Sign-off is recorded against the version, with a name and a timestamp.

A share link for every version, and every round on record.

Read receipts and first-view logging. You know who opened it, and when.

Clients comment on the frame itself. No login, no account.

Team-only comments, right next to the client feedback, hidden from guests.
